finding.text: The variants call the third limit "weekly, one model" while today's meter right above calls it "weekly — Fable", so one limit has two names on the same page (content: one name every time). See shots/…-usage/1200.png: band 2 says "weekly — Fable" and bands 3–4 say "weekly, one model". The cause is `UsagePace.KINDS`, which ignores the model name that `usage_rail`'s label_of uses.

A's caption says "The bar is how far ahead of the clock you are", but every shot shows all three limits under pace (33%, 88%, 85%). A better caption: "The bar is your spend divided by the clock" (content: says exactly what it means).

On /framework/ai/usage/ the AI page's tab bar still highlights INBOX, so the tabs say you are on the inbox when you are not (navigation: active state). See shots/…-usage/400.png and 1200.png, top band.
The parent `ai/readme.md` does not mention `usage/`. The page is reachable through `children:`, but the readme index skips it (readmes: index every system).
